description: The plot illustrates relative change (in percent) across grouped transformer layer ranges for several KV-cache token/precision configurations, with a horizontal baseline reference. The x-axis is categorical with five labeled groups—“Layer1-4,” “Layer5-12,” “Layer13-20,” “Layer21-28,” and “Layer29-32”—spaced evenly. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 5%, 0%, −5%, −10%, and −15%, spanning approximately from +5% at the top to about −15% at the bottom; a gray dashed horizontal line marks the 0% baseline (“Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit”). One series is a yellow solid line with circular markers (legend label not fully visible due to an overlaid gray rectangle); it is near 0% at Layer1-4, around −1% at Layer5-12, returns to about 0% at Layer13-20, sits slightly below 0% at Layer21-28, and ends slightly above 0% at Layer29-32. The “LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit” series is a red solid line with square markers, starting slightly above 0% at Layer1-4, dropping to roughly −2% to −3% at Layer5-12, staying around −2% at Layer13-20 and Layer21-28, and rising back to about 0% at Layer29-32. The “RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit” series is a light-blue solid line with circular markers, starting near 0% at Layer1-4, decreasing to around −3% at Layer5-12 and about −6% at Layer13-20, then increasing to roughly −4% at Layer21-28 and ending near −1% at Layer29-32. The “RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit” series is a dark-blue solid line with square markers, starting around −1% at Layer1-4, dropping to about −5% to −6% at Layer5-12 and reaching its lowest point near −15% at Layer13-20, then rising to around −11% at Layer21-28 and ending near −2% at Layer29-32.
